---
description: holiday_set as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
doing: putting a holiday on the calendar
arguments:
  holiday: "The holiday or named day, by name or id; one that is there is changed, any other is added."
  label: "Its name as the calendar shows it."
  date: "The day of the year it falls on, MM-DD."
  rule: "Its rule, for a day that does not fall on a fixed date: fixed, nth_weekday, easter or relative."
  day_off: "true when it is a day off; false for a named day that is not."
  source: "Where it comes from: from is prose, lore, author, gm, character, player, default or invented; lore, message and roll cite an entry, a message or a roll by id; an invention cites its gap_check and consent."
  precision: "How exact: exact, approximate, vague or unknown."
  standing: "How it stands: established, proposed or assumed."
---
Adds a holiday or named day to the calendar, or changes one that is there. A named day is a holiday that is no day off. The world's own calendar is never edited: what the story changes is kept with this chat.
